name: Ocean Capital Acquisition Corporation Ordinary Shares
summary: Ocean Capital Acquisition Corp. operates as a blank check company. It was incorporated in the British Virgin Islands as a business company with limited liability for the purpose of effecting into a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, recapitalization, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses or entities. The company was founded on August 20, 2021 and is headquartered in Wilmington, DE.
